use_when: to show many records with the same fields, such as orders or stock.
when people need to compare values across rows.
Put the most important column first, such as the order ID or book title.
Use Badge cells for status, and Toggle or Action cells for quick changes.

dont_use_when.when: with text that wraps. Keep rows on one line; long text ends with "…".
Do not show a status with color alone. Badges always include text.
Do not put more than one button in a row.

best_practice: Right-align numbers and their headers, so the digits line up.
Use Muted text for secondary information, such as times and authors.
Keep column headers to one or two words.

variant_intent.cell type=Number: Number cell (TableCell, code). Figma: right-align numbers and their headers.
variant_intent.cell type=Toggle: Figma: Toggle cells for quick changes.
variant_intent.cell type=Action: Figma: Action cells for quick changes.
variant_intent.cell emphasis=Muted: Figma: Muted text for secondary information, such as times and authors.

placement: Use one table per page, placed under the Top Bar.
Search and the main action live in the title bar; row actions sit in the last column.

a11y.fact: The More action is a native <button> with aria-label "More".
The Toggle cell passes an aria-label to its Toggle.
The More button shows a focus ring on keyboard focus.
